splits.train: global_splits.json:train; fit model and normalization only
splits.validation: global_splits.json:val; checkpoint selection and stopping only
splits.evaluation: global_splits.json:eval; locked until all arms and failure records freeze
splits.normalization: fit on train once per data manifest; reuse unchanged on val/eval and every arm

evaluation.hdr90: segment endpoint membership in the model's 90% highest-density region; report coverage and abs(coverage-0.90)
evaluation.bootstrap: paired segment-level block bootstrap, B=2000, resample identical segment_id blocks for every contrast
evaluation.convergence: report converged flag, iterations/epochs, final objective, selected checkpoint and all numerical failures
evaluation.bridge_dual: full-horizon existence/exclusion check: pi_exist+surv_excl=1 and pi*p_exist+(1-pi)*p_excl=p; report absolute identity error and reconstruction L1
evaluation.delta_probe: delta=0.3*sigma_hist, where sigma_hist is train-split-only robust scale 1.4826*MAD of endpoint displacement in normalized coordinates; use only to dilate/erode the bridge event region in a predeclared sensitivity probe

reporting.capacity_scan: ordered trend with simultaneous 95% family-wise intervals; Holm-adjust the three adjacent contrasts within each model family
reporting.structure_contrast: one predeclared paired contrast I1-K10 minus neural-H8; separate Holm family from the two capacity scans
reporting.seeds: use and report only the registered seed 20260814; any diagnostic rerun is labeled non-confirmatory
reporting.failures: intention-to-run denominator; no metric imputation; report failure count and reason beside successful-run summaries
